subject.title: Cron jobs stall during AI model calls (model_call:stream_progress never completes)

question: Should cron `wake` `mode:"now"` report only enqueue success, or should it wait for and surface heartbeat execution failure, and should that remaining Bug 3 be split out before closing this bundled issue?
rationale: Current main has resolved the model-call stall path, but changing wake success semantics affects the public tool/RPC contract and may alter existing fire-and-forget callers.

options.title: Split Bug 3 and close after link
options.body: Open or designate a focused cron wake contract issue, link it here, and close this bundled report once the model-stall fix ships.

options.title: Keep this issue scoped to wake
options.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical tracker for the wake-now contract until the behavior is decided and fixed.

options.title: Document enqueue-only semantics
options.body: Keep `{ok:true}` as enqueue success and document that heartbeat or delivery failure is reported separately, accepting the current user-facing ambiguity.

recommendation.title: Split Bug 3 and close after link
recommendation.body: Open or designate a focused cron wake contract issue, link it here, and close this bundled report once the model-stall fix ships.
